title: Visual
description: viz/<slug>/visual.json: one visual's catalogue entry and how its checks run. The folder name is the slug, the page is index.html, and every path is relative to the folder unless it says otherwise.

data.description: The data file published beside the page as data.json.

links.description: Typed links to other records on the site, which adds the reverse link to each target.

assets.description: Further files of the folder published beside index.html at the same relative path.

downloads.description: A JSON file whose downloads list (path, https url, sha256, bytes) pins files too large for Git; the site fetches and publishes them.

published.description: false for a visual the site does not publish; published when absent.

uses.description: Shared files or folders outside viz/, relative to the repository root, that this visual depends on: a change to one runs the checks of every visual that lists it instead of every visual.

checks.description: Shell commands run from the folder in place of the default checks (build.py --verify, node --test and unittest over tests/).

allow.description: Findings of a deterministic check that the visual keeps on purpose, each as the check prints it after the visual's name but without the line number after the file name, so an edit elsewhere in the file does not break it; scripts/rules.py and scripts/deadcode.mjs say what each check reports. Each entry allows one finding: list it twice to allow two identical findings. An entry that matches no finding fails the check, so the list cannot go stale.

typecheck.description: How scripts/typecheck.mjs extracts the page's inline scripts for the folder's tsconfig.json.

page.description: The HTML whose inline scripts are extracted, when not index.html: a page with another name, or a builder's template whose inlined src/ files tsc checks directly.

skip.description: Inline script blocks left out: an id, or a folder file (an entry ending in .js) whose inlined copy is left out, such as the beamdswitch template.
